posts.title: The end of the beginning
posts.description: Thinking about Anthropic, it’s strange to imagine a product as profound and pathbreaking as Claude to be “merely” its Apple II. Yet that’s surely correct. This sentiment feels right. We’re just at the beginning. It feels a little bit like slowly and then all at once, with the progress of AI. But there’s a lot more to explore. A lot.

posts.title: It's the little things
posts.description: Maybe it's okay that we have agents now. The interesting hard part about programming, where you'd get in a flow state and stay there, keeping the problem in your head for hours, I think that time is gone.
